## Overview

**Used Car Price Prediction** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Three-month capstone: scrape → EDA → linear/Ridge/Lasso/polynomial regression.

## Background & Motivation

**Used Car Price Prediction** — three-month PDS timeline in guideline PDF.

Used imported cars dominate Cambodian classifieds; transparent valuation from mileage, year, and brand reduces asymmetric information between buyer and seller.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

**From *Project guidelines* (timeline):**

- **Month 1:** Web scraping → store CSV; web research; data overview; variable selection
- **Month 2:** EDA — continuous/categorical feature distributions, target distribution
- **Month 3:** Preprocessing (outliers, encoding) → **Linear, Ridge, Lasso, Polynomial** regression + feature engineering + correlation matrix

## Data Collection & Preparation

Scraped used-car listings; CSV after month-1 scrape phase.

## Methodology & Analysis

Structured 3-month capstone: EDA → clean → polynomial and regularized regression suite.

## Model Evaluation

Correlation analysis; compare linear and regularized models on test split.

## Results & Key Learnings

Documented semester arc from scrape to valuation model—strong teaching portfolio artifact.
